item.title: Daily digest — 2026-08-02
item.description:
Our open-source research community has seen significant progress across multiple projects. Notably, the `scienceverse/metacheck` and `giladfeldman/docpluck` projects have made strides in enhancing data processing capabilities and resolving text loss issues, respectively. Meanwhile, `Davidvandijcke/coarse` has released version 1.9.0, featuring improved security and new models, while `JamieCummins/regcheck` has addressed several bugs and updated its demo page. Additionally, `giladfeldman/escicheck` has synchronized its main branch with `escicheckapp` to reflect the latest changes. These updates demonstrate the community's commitment to improving research tools and highlight the connections between projects, such as the focus on data processing and text analysis. Overall, it's an exciting time for our community, with many projects pushing forward and collaborating to advance open-source research.

item.title: metacheck: 1 commit today
item.description:
scienceverse/metacheck

The `data_check` branch was the focus of recent work, where the code and output formats being processed were updated, and dedicated import and export of files were added. As stated, this update involved changing the code to handle specific output formats. Additionally, the `data_check` branch also saw the addition of "stat output", which was committed separately. The work on the `data_check` branch appears to be focused on enhancing the data processing capabilities. No other branches were worked on during this time.
